title: Certified Per-Instance Unlearning Using Individual Sensitivity Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2602.15602v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Certified machine unlearning can be achieved through noise injection, with differential privacy guarantees obtained by calibrating the noise to worst-case sensitivity. Yet, the influence of individual training points is highly heterogeneous, making such uniform calibration unnecessarily conservative for most deletion requests. We consider certified per-instance unlearning, a data-dependent notion of certified deletion in which the unlearning mechanism and its certificate can adapt to the point being removed. Our framework turns point-specific sensitivity information into formal unlearning guarantees, allowing the amount of noise to reflect the difficulty of the deletion request rather than the worst case. When training is deterministic, we derive explicit per-instance unlearning certificates. For noisy gradient descent, in the case of ridge regression, similar certificates are obtained through high-probability sensitivity bound

translated_title: 基于个体敏感性界的可认证逐实例遗忘
translated_abstract: 认证式机器遗忘可以通过注入噪声来实现，并通过将噪声校准至最坏情况敏感性来获得差分隐私保证。然而，单个训练点的影响具有高度异构性，使得这种统一校准对于大多数删除请求而言过于保守。我们研究了可认证的逐实例遗忘，这是可认证删除的一种数据依赖概念，其中遗忘机制及其证书能够适应被删除的特定数据点。我们的框架将针对特定数据点的敏感性信息转化为正式的遗忘保证，使噪声量能够反映删除请求的实际难度而非最坏情况。当训练过程是确定性的，我们推导出了显式的逐实例遗忘证书。对于噪声梯度下降，在岭回归的情形下，通过高概率敏感性界也获得了类似的证书。
tldr: 提出可认证逐实例遗忘框架，利用单个训练点的个体敏感性界自适应调整噪声量，避免最坏情况校准带来的过度保守性，并为确定性训练及岭回归的噪声梯度下降推导出显式遗忘证书。
en_tdlr: Proposes a certified per-instance unlearning framework that adapts noise levels to individual training-point sensitivity bounds, avoiding overly conservative worst-case calibration, and derives explicit unlearning certificates for deterministic training and for noisy gradient descent in ridge regression.
